excerpts.content:
Kintsugi spec has been updated to `v2`
http://spec.merge.wiki/

This is a breaking change to the engine API such that the call to `forkchoiceUpdated` returns the `payloadId` rather than both layers calculating it. Additionally, CL specs have a couple of very minor typing fixes and additional units tests.

Unless otherwise noted, Kintsugi🍵  `v2` will be the target for next week's devnet launch 🚀
